warning_texts: The machine rule caveats_declared matches fixed opening phrases only, so an estimate caveat that begins with the right words and then reverses its meaning passes; the CLM-COMPLETION-PARTNER inversion reached this gate with every machine check green.

Both test claims store p as 0.0000000000 with display_digits 4, which would render as a p of exactly zero; the release should show it as below 0.0001, since the recomputed p underflows rather than being zero.

Both test claims record alpha 0.05 with correction bonferroni but never write the per-test threshold of 0.025 that the correction implies; the conclusion is unaffected because both p values are far below it.

metrics/calculated_metrics.json gives channel_aov_test_p_value, _statistic and _effect the same all-orders population text as the claim; that metric-registry wording belongs to worker_metrics and should be corrected with the claim.

The completion-rate claims don't say in their caveats that cancelled and pending orders are in the denominator; the data confirm they are (direct 3322 cancelled + 3457 pending in 24597, partner 3845 + 4034 in 19934), so this is a wording gap, not a calculation fault.

Only claims_recomputed goes back to the raw export (raw_latest); recompute_estimate, recompute_test and min_group_size read clean_data/orders_clean.csv, so the intervals, tests and group sizes stand on the clean table. My recount from the quarantine projection agrees with all of them.

The plan assumption that neither channel changed how it books orders during the quarter can't be tested from the export; monthly strata are stable (direct minus partner completion 0.127, 0.103, 0.129 by month).
summary: All eight claims recompute from quarantine/orders.csv (dedup last-row-wins, Q1 by order_month, negative refunds excluded) to the register and the metrics byte for byte, and the claim -> metric -> plan chain closes on 146 field checks. The claims fail on text, not numbers: CLM-COMPLETION-PARTNER's interval caveat is inverted and asserts the interval covers a changing country mix; both CLM-AOV-* claims never say in their caveats that they are delivered-only and net of refunds; and CLM-TEST-CHANNEL-AOV states an all-orders population for a test run on delivered orders only.
